author: Newracom, Inc.
$comment: Scope: the bundled armhf Wireshark 4.0.5 build under
third_party.json gives the bundled packages the upstream Wireshark CPE, so
NVD matching works without a distro hint. That is intentional - silence here
would be a matching failure, not an absence of vulnerabilities.
All seven are recorded as 'affected'. None is suppressed. Claiming
not_affected would require asserting what the customer does with the tool,
which we cannot know: the vulnerable code is present in the build we ship.
The action_statement gives the remedy instead.
Source: Wireshark 4.0.6 release notes (7 CVEs, plus wnpa-sec-2023-14 GDSDB
and wnpa-sec-2023-20 XRA infinite loops which carry no CVE ID and therefore
cannot appear in a scanner report).
MAINTENANCE: reconcile this file against the actual grype output each
release. Statements for CVEs that no scanner reports are harmless; findings
with no statement are what the release gate stops on.

statements.action_statement: Triggered by opening a malformed capture file in the BLF format. The documented workflow for these packages is live capture to pcapng and does not read that format, but the affected code is present in this build. These packages are an optional evaluation convenience for the NRC7394 EVK. They are not loaded on the NRC7394 device and are not part of the product's runtime. To remove this finding, install Wireshark from your distribution's package repository and delete the bundled .deb files under package/evk/sw_pkg/nrc_pkg/script/sniffer/; the documented capture workflow is unchanged. Fixed upstream in Wireshark 4.0.6.
